rules: Use exact catalogue titles. Male and female versions of a player contribution share title and rarity; they are not gender variants of the historical figure.
Core parent art uses base rank. No resolved milestone is associated with this art pack.
Demetrius can use Legendary only after successful rhodes-captured in the alternate-history branch; title Demetrius, captor of Rhodes.
Ptolemy can use Legendary only after successful ptolemaic-dynasty-founded; promoted title Ptolemy I Soter, founder of the Ptolemaic dynasty.
Zeno can use Legendary only after successful stoic-school-established; promoted title Zeno of Citium, founder of a Stoic school. This gate is provisional in policy.
Nearchus/Eumenes parent and title assets use Epic frame styling as an editorial default only; their numeric gameplay rarity is unspecified.
Player-title prestige/ordinary storage kind does not define collectible rarity.
No assigned owner or issued copy exists for this preview pack. Show ART PREVIEW and limit only; do not invent a numerator, token id, owner, mint date, or accepted player work.
Any collection index is a design identifier, never a minted copy number.
Keep title aliases as lookup aliases rather than inventing additional artwork or claiming personal pupil relationships.
